name: Deus Ex
notes: Buy Deus Ex: Game of the Year Edition on GOG (DRM-free). Install it on any PC — or unpack the offline installer .exe with innoextract (Windows not required; the game needs no registry entries) — then copy the game folder (the one containing System/ and Maps/) to this device and select it here.
A modern Direct3D 9 renderer is downloaded (checksum-verified) and configured automatically, capped at 60 fps — Unreal Engine 1 literally speeds up the game above that.
Touch tips: the right stick aims, USE is the right mouse button — it picks up items and opens doors. CROUCH stays held until you tap it again.
